name: Daniel Webster's Chowder
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 6 pounds sea bass or cod, cut into slices

steps: Fry the onion with the fatty pork. Transfer to a large pot.
Add all remaining ingredients to pot.
Add enough water to cover everything by 1 inch.
Bring to a boil. Simmer for 1 hour, stirring gently every so often.

culture.text: Chowder is a type of thick soup prepared with milk or cream, a roux, and seafood or vegetables. Oyster crackers or saltines may accompany chowders as a side item, and cracker pieces may be dropped atop the dish.
